title: manuscript-guard literature ledger
description: Numbers taken from the literature, each bound to a stored source. Values the author verified from a source the toolkit could not retrieve do NOT belong here; they belong in attested.yaml, so that the set resting on human attestation stays separately auditable.

citekey.description: Better BibTeX citation key, pinned. An unpinned key can mutate when metadata changes and silently break a build that was green yesterday.

depth.description: abstract-only is reported but never fails a build; it exists so a reviewer can see which figures rest on an abstract.

source_file.description: Path relative to literature/, e.g. sources/smith2020Prevalence.pdf.

locator.description: Where in the source, e.g. 'Table 2, p. 415'. Precise enough for someone else to check without reading the whole paper.

quote.description: Verbatim text containing the value. This is the evidence; a ledger entry without it is an assertion.
